field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable Kea-to-Unbound DDNS registration. On enable, the plugin turns on Kea's DDNS daemon and configures it automatically — no per-subnet setup required.

field.label: Qualifying suffix
field.help: Domain appended to bare hostnames to form FQDNs. Leave blank to use the firewall's domain.

field.label: Authoritative DHCPv4
field.help: Kea answers requests for addresses it does not know with a NAK at once, instead of ignoring them (clients then fall back to DISCOVER immediately).

field.label: Reverse zones (PTR)
field.help: Register PTR records for these reverse zones directly at an external DNS server (e.g. Active Directory). One zone per line, "zone = server[, fallback]", e.g. 10.in-addr.arpa = 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.11. Plain lines are sent unsigned (the zone must allow non-secure updates); add the word gss at the end to sign with GSS-TSIG instead. Zones listed here are not written to Unbound. Lines starting with # are comments.

field.label: GSS-TSIG (Kerberos)
field.help: Sign PTR updates for reverse zones marked "gss" with GSS-TSIG. Requires the os-kea-unbound-gss-tsig package, a Kerberos setup (krb5.conf) and a keytab. Without the package the zones fall back to unsigned updates.

field.label: Kerberos KDCs
field.help: The domain controllers, comma or space separated, e.g. 192.0.2.10 192.0.2.11. The plugin generates /usr/local/etc/krb5.conf from realm, KDCs and domain, but never overwrites a krb5.conf it did not write itself. Leave empty to manage krb5.conf by hand.

field.label: Kerberos DNS domain
field.help: Optional: DNS domain mapped to the realm, e.g. ad.example.com.

field.label: Client principal
field.help: Principal of the keytab, e.g. DHCP/fw.ad.example.com@AD.EXAMPLE.COM.

field.label: Keytab file
field.help: Where the uploaded keytab is stored on the firewall (mode 600, owned by root; upload it at the top of this page). Must be under /usr/local/etc/. Default /usr/local/etc/kea/dhcp.keytab.

field.label: GSS DNS servers
field.help: The DNS servers of "gss" zones with their host names, one per line: ip = fqdn, e.g. 192.0.2.10 = dc01.ad.example.com. The service principal becomes DNS/fqdn@REALM.

field.label: GSS anti-replay
field.help: Enable the GSS anti-replay service (default). Needed with a Windows Server 2022 DNS server, which refused signed updates without it. The Kea manual warns that some Microsoft DNS servers dislike it; if updates are refused, try switching it off.

field.label: Aggressive cleanup
field.help: When a host gets a new address, remove older addresses Kea no longer recognises for that host.

field.label: Update on renew
field.help: Re-assert DNS records on every lease renewal (more resilient, more DDNS traffic). Off = update only on a new or changed lease.

field.label: TSIG authentication
field.help: Authenticate DDNS updates with an auto-generated TSIG key (recommended).

field.label: Listener port
field.help: Loopback UDP port for the DDNS listener. Default 53535.
